title: The third moment of the cutoff fourth Wick chaos is an exact triangle graph of order at most N^6

third_moment_triangle.notation: On normalized T3 let V_N=integral :phi_N(x)^4: dx, C_N(x-y)=E(phi_N(x)phi_N(y)), sigma_N^2=E(V_N^2)=24 integral C_N(z)^4 dz and S_N=integral C_N(z)^2 dz=sum_k q_k^2
third_moment_triangle.unique_contraction_graph: For three normal-ordered degree-four vertices, every field must contract across distinct vertices. The degree equations force exactly two edges between each pair of vertices
third_moment_triangle.contraction_count: The number of labeled contractions is (4!)^3/(2!)^3=1728
third_moment_triangle.exact_formula: m3_N=E(V_N^3)=1728 integral integral C_N(x)^2 C_N(y)^2 C_N(x-y)^2 dx dy
third_moment_triangle.positivity: The exact integrand is a product of three squares, so m3_N>=0 even when C_N changes sign
third_moment_triangle.young_bound: With f_N=C_N^2, the triangle integral is <f_N*f_N,f_N><=||f_N||_1||f_N||_2^2=S_N integral C_N^4
third_moment_triangle.three_dimensional_order: For beta=1 in d=3, S_N=O(N), sigma_N^2=Theta(N^5), and consequently m3_N=O(N^6)
third_moment_triangle.ceiling: The estimate is an upper bound and supplies no matching asymptotic constant for m3_N or two-sided ground-energy asymptotic. It applies to the declared real Gaussian beta-one sharp-cutoff control, not a source-owned GU field measure
